_about: Demo sign-in for the portal and for tests: who the user is decides their tier and which customers' orders they may see.
This stands in for the company's real sign-in, which would supply the same two facts. There are no passwords.
customer_ids: the customers whose orders this user may see. 'all' = every order (internal staff).
tier_c_without_customer: what an external (tier C) user with no known customer may see. 'allow' keeps today's
behaviour until the app passes a signed-in customer; set it to 'deny' once it does.
